class.name: OcgStandardTransient
class.brief_description: Abstract class which forms the root of the entire Transient class hierarchy.
class.description: ! Abstract class which forms the root of the entire ! Transient class hierarchy.

method.name: IsInstance_1
method.description: Returns a true value if this is an instance of Type.

method.name: IsInstance_2
method.description: Returns a true value if this is an instance of TypeName.

method.name: IsKind_1
method.description: Returns true if this is an instance of Type or an instance of any class that inherits from Type. Note that multiple inheritance is not supported by OCCT RTTI mechanism.

method.name: IsKind_2
method.description: Returns true if this is an instance of TypeName or an instance of any class that inherits from TypeName. Note that multiple inheritance is not supported by OCCT RTTI mechanism.

method.name: GetRefCount
method.description: Get the reference counter of this object

method.name: IncrementRefCounter
method.description: Increments the reference counter of this object

method.name: DecrementRefCounter
method.description: Decrements the reference counter of this object; returns the decremented value
